decisions.reason: The inertial measurement sensor module is close to the firm's sensor and control knowledge, allowing the firm to assimilate market feedback and improve it, so the probability of withdrawal remains low.
This module builds directly on the firm's existing power and input modules and already has its own page, indicating strong absorptive capacity and a very low drop risk.
The monitoring sensor kit builds on the firm's existing sensing and kit offerings, enabling the firm to leverage related knowledge and keep the product.
The RGB LED control module builds on established control and firmware expertise, but as a 2024 launch the firm is still interpreting early results, resulting in a moderate but low drop probability.
The remote access service for wallboxes extends the firm's charging and energy-management capabilities into a strategic area, so the firm can learn from early feedback and is unlikely to drop it.
